title: R-2 transform route T1: offering stage-1 attacks to a face-down Fossil Ditto when the copied form is fixed by public information (design only)

T1-C1.condition: real card's only power is TransformIntoDefender; basic, not baby; no printed attack

T1-C2.condition: opponent active present and face up

T1-C3.condition: defender not disguised, not trainer-as-pokemon, not evolution without base (TF2, TF3)

T1-C4.condition: no defender power stopped by copied_power_problem; not baby form with opponent scare

T1-C7.condition: face-down invariants (no damage, conditions, persistent effects, stack)
